name: Chimera
description: A downturned lace-up shoe for steep bouldering and sport climbing, with a forefoot support plate, extensive toe rubber and a tensioned heel.

officialSpecs.upper: Hyperskin + leather footbed + Alcantara toe pocket

name: Drago
description: A soft, aggressively downturned shoe for steep bouldering and competition-style movement, with SRT forefoot rubber and a PCB-Tension platform.

name: Drago LV
description: A low-volume version of the soft Drago for steep bouldering and competition-style movement, with SRT forefoot rubber and a PAF heel.

name: Furia Air
description: An ultralight, soft shoe for steep bouldering and competition-style movement, using a flexible construction, Z-strap and high-friction outsole.

name: Instinct VS
description: A moderately downturned shoe for bouldering and sport climbing, with a hook-and-loop closure, Bi-Tension support and an edging-focused outsole.

name: Instinct VSR
description: A softer Instinct variant for steep bouldering and sport climbing, with Bi-Tension support, toe and heel rubber, and a friction-focused outsole.

name: Vapor V
description: A moderately downturned all-around shoe for gym and outdoor climbing, with dual hook-and-loop straps and Bi-Tension forefoot support.

name: Veloce
description: A soft indoor climbing shoe with a slightly downturned shape, roomy toe box, Z-strap closure and a half-length outsole.
